mode: Offline via school, or online direct
note: Through your school: offline exam on 20 Nov or 2 Dec 2026. Without the school: parents can register directly online and the child takes the exam from home — practice test 17 Jan 2027, final 24 Jan 2027. Time (both days): Class 2 & 3: 10–11 am · Class 1: 11:45 am–12:45 pm · Class 4 & 5: 2–3 pm. Registration was open as of 12 Nov 2026.
